title: Energy Bills Set to Rise Sharply in January
subtitle: Millions of households face higher costs as global gas prices surge due to conflict.

summary.en: Energy bills for millions of households in England, Scotland, and Wales will rise by 26% starting in January. The increase is driven by a surge in wholesale gas prices caused by the war in Iran. Ofgem, the energy regulator, has set a new price cap to limit how much suppliers can charge per unit of energy. To help with these costs, the government is providing a £100 payment to many households. Experts recommend that families take steps to save energy and check if they are eligible for additional financial support.
summary.zh: 英格蘭、蘇格蘭與威爾斯的數百萬家庭，自一月起能源帳單將上漲百分之二十六。此漲幅是由於伊朗戰爭導致批發天然氣價格飆升所致。能源監管機構英國天然氣與電力市場辦公室已設定新的價格上限，以限制供應商對每單位能源的收費。為協助應對這些成本，政府將向許多家庭發放一百英鎊的補助。專家建議家庭採取節能措施，並檢查自己是否符合領取額外財務支援的資格。

paragraphs.en: Millions of households across England, Scotland, and Wales are preparing for a significant increase in their energy bills this winter. Starting in January, energy costs are expected to rise by 26% as a direct result of a sharp increase in wholesale gas prices. According to BBC Business, this price hike is primarily driven by the ongoing war in Iran, which has caused global energy markets to become unstable. The increase represents the largest jump in costs since the conflict in Ukraine first pushed prices up.
paragraphs.zh: 英格蘭、蘇格蘭與威爾斯的數百萬家庭正準備迎接今年冬天能源帳單的大幅上漲。自一月起，由於批發天然氣價格急劇攀升，能源成本預計將上漲百分之二十六。根據英國廣播公司商業新聞（BBC Business）報導，這波漲價主要源於伊朗持續進行的戰爭，導致全球能源市場陷入不穩定。此次漲幅是自烏克蘭衝突首次推高價格以來，成本最大的一次跳升。

paragraphs.en: Ofgem, the organization that regulates the energy market, sets a price cap every three months. This cap does not limit the total amount a household pays, but it does set a maximum price for each unit of gas and electricity used. For those on variable tariffs—plans where the price can change—the cost of electricity will rise from 26.32p to 32.69p per kilowatt-hour. Gas prices will also increase from 7.97p to 10.96p per kilowatt-hour. These changes mean that a typical household could see their monthly bill increase by about £37, though this figure could climb closer to £60 during the coldest winter months depending on individual energy usage.
paragraphs.zh: 負責監管能源市場的英國天然氣與電力市場辦公室（Ofgem）每三個月會設定一次價格上限。此上限並非限制家庭支付的總金額，而是針對每單位天然氣與電力的使用設定最高價格。對於採用浮動費率（即價格會隨市場變動的方案）的用戶而言，電費將從每度電二十六點三二便士漲至三十二點六九便士。天然氣價格也將從每度七點九七便士漲至十點九六便士。這些變動意味著一般家庭的月帳單可能會增加約三十七英鎊，而在最寒冷的冬季月份，根據個人能源使用情況，此數字可能會更接近六十英鎊。

paragraphs.en: Dame Clare Moriarty, the chief executive of Citizens Advice, described the situation as a "brutal winter" for many families. There is growing concern that these higher costs will lead to increased debt and a greater need for emergency support. In response, the government has announced a £100 payment for millions of households to help cover winter energy costs. This support is in addition to an existing reduction in VAT, which is a tax on goods and services, on electricity bills. Furthermore, the "warm home discount" will provide £150 off bills for six million households that receive government benefits.
paragraphs.zh: 英國公民諮詢局（Citizens Advice）執行長克萊爾·莫里亞蒂女爵（Dame Clare Moriarty）形容，對許多家庭來說，這將是一個「殘酷的冬天」。外界日益擔憂這些高昂的成本將導致債務增加，並加劇對緊急援助的需求。對此，政府已宣布向數百萬家庭發放一百英鎊的補助，以協助支付冬季能源費用。這項補助是現行電費加值型營業稅（VAT，即針對商品與服務徵收的稅）減免之外的額外措施。此外，「溫暖家庭折扣」計畫將為六百萬領取政府福利的家庭提供一百五十英鎊的帳單折抵。

paragraphs.en: While the government and regulators are working to provide support, some groups are calling for more action. Campaign groups such as Friends of the Earth and Global Witness have pointed out that major oil and energy companies are making large profits while households struggle to pay their bills. Energy UK, which represents energy suppliers, noted that while these companies see higher profits in cash terms, their profit margins are actually capped by the regulator. They argue that the companies that send your bill do not benefit from the high wholesale prices in the same way that international energy producers do.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管政府與監管機構正致力於提供支援，但部分團體呼籲採取更多行動。如「地球之友」（Friends of the Earth）與「全球見證」（Global Witness）等倡議團體指出，在家庭苦於支付帳單之際，大型石油與能源公司卻獲利豐厚。代表能源供應商的「英國能源」（Energy UK）則表示，雖然這些公司在現金帳面上獲利較高，但其利潤率實際上受到監管機構的限制。他們主張，向民眾收取帳單的公司，並未像國際能源生產商那樣從高昂的批發價格中獲益。

paragraphs.en: For many families, the challenge will be managing these higher costs during the coldest part of the year. Experts suggest that households can take several practical steps to keep their bills in check. One of the most effective ways to save money is to reduce overall energy consumption. Simple habits, such as turning down the thermostat by one degree, closing curtains at night to keep heat in, and washing clothes at lower temperatures, can make a meaningful difference. Additionally, turning down the flow temperature on a combi boiler can help the system run more efficiently.
paragraphs.zh: 對許多家庭而言，挑戰在於如何在一年中最寒冷的時期管理這些高昂的成本。專家建議，家庭可以採取幾項實用的步驟來控制帳單。最有效的省錢方式之一是降低整體的能源消耗。一些簡單的習慣，例如將恆溫器調低一度、晚上拉上窗簾以保持室內溫度，以及以較低的水溫洗衣服，都能產生顯著的差異。此外，調低組合式鍋爐（combi boiler）的供水溫度，也有助於提升系統運作效率。

paragraphs.en: How a household pays for their energy also matters. BBC Business reports that paying by direct debit is typically cheaper than paying by standard credit when a bill arrives. Customers are encouraged to provide regular meter readings to ensure their bills are accurate rather than based on estimates. For those who are worried about future price changes, switching to a fixed-rate tariff is an option. However, experts warn that it is currently difficult to know if a fixed deal is the best choice, as prices could potentially fall later in the year. Consumers are advised to look at all available deals and carefully check for any exit fees before signing a new agreement.
paragraphs.zh: 家庭支付能源費用的方式也很重要。英國廣播公司商業新聞報導指出，通常情況下，透過自動轉帳支付比在收到帳單後以標準信用卡支付更便宜。建議客戶定期提供電表讀數，以確保帳單準確，而非依賴預估值。對於擔心未來價格變動的用戶，轉換為固定費率方案是一個選擇。然而，專家警告，目前很難判斷固定費率是否為最佳選擇，因為價格在今年稍晚時可能會下跌。建議消費者在簽署新合約前，先查看所有可用的方案，並仔細檢查是否有任何解約費用。

paragraphs.en: Finally, it is important to note that the price cap system is designed to reflect the costs faced by energy suppliers. Because the cap is set based on data from a three-month period that ends several weeks before the new rates start, the recent drop in international wholesale prices will not be reflected in the January cap. However, there is hope that these lower wholesale costs will lead to a more favorable price cap when the next update occurs in April. Until then, officials are urging energy suppliers to identify customers who need help early and to ensure that any repayment plans offered are affordable and sustainable for those struggling to make ends meet.
paragraphs.zh: 最後，必須注意的是，價格上限系統的設計旨在反映能源供應商所面臨的成本。由於上限是根據新費率生效前數週結束的三個月期間數據所設定，因此近期國際批發價格的下跌，將不會反映在一月份的價格上限中。不過，外界仍希望這些較低的批發成本能在四月份下次更新時，帶來更優惠的價格上限。在此之前，官員敦促能源供應商儘早找出需要協助的客戶，並確保所提供的任何還款計畫，對於那些難以維持生計的民眾而言是負擔得起且具備永續性的。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To set a maximum limit on an amount or price.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 設定上限（通常指價格或金額）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（帽子），這裡作動詞用。文中：their profit margins are actually capped by the regulator.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Under control; kept at a manageable level.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 受到控制、保持在可控範圍內。
keyTerms.noteZh: 這是一個固定搭配，容易誤解為「在支票裡」。文中：Experts suggest that households can take several practical steps to keep their bills in check.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To have just enough money to pay for the things that you need.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 勉強維持生計、收支平衡。
keyTerms.noteZh: 這是一個常見的慣用語，字面意思與實際意義不同。文中：ensure that any repayment plans offered are affordable and sustainable for those struggling to make ends meet.

quiz.question: According to the article, why will the January energy price cap not immediately reflect recent drops in international wholesale gas prices?

options.A: The government has intentionally kept prices high to encourage energy conservation.
options.B: The cap is calculated using data from a three-month period that concludes weeks before the new rates begin.
options.C: Energy suppliers are required by law to maintain the same prices for at least six months.
options.D: Ofgem is currently prioritizing the profits of energy companies over consumer savings.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第七段，價格上限的設定是基於新費率生效前數週結束的三個月數據，因此無法即時反映最新的批發價格變動。選項 A 文章未提及；選項 C 錯誤，因為上限每三個月調整一次；選項 D 雖然提到公司獲利爭議，但並非價格上限滯後的原因。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided, what can be inferred about the relationship between energy suppliers and wholesale gas producers?

options.A: Energy suppliers and wholesale producers are usually the same companies.
options.B: Energy suppliers are currently experiencing record-breaking profit margins due to the crisis.
options.C: Energy suppliers are limited in how much profit they can make by the regulator.
options.D: Energy suppliers are directly responsible for the global instability in energy markets.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。第四段提到 Energy UK 指出，雖然能源供應商帳面上的現金獲利看似增加，但其利潤率實際上受到監管機構（Ofgem）的限制，且他們並未像國際能源生產商那樣從高批發價中獲得同樣的利益。選項 A 與文章陳述矛盾；選項 B 忽略了利潤率受限的事實；選項 D 將責任歸咎於供應商，但文章指出市場不穩是源於戰爭。

quiz.question: In the fifth paragraph, what does the phrase 'keep their bills in check' mean?

options.A: To verify that the information on the bill is accurate.
options.B: To pay the bills promptly before the deadline.
options.C: To prevent the costs from rising too high.
options.D: To organize bills into a record-keeping system.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。在此語境下，「keep something in check」意指「控制、限制（某事）」，避免其失控或過度膨脹。文章隨後建議透過降低溫度、關窗等節能方式來省錢，這正是為了控制帳單金額。選項 A 混淆了「核對帳單」與「控制支出」；選項 B 與 D 則偏離了「控制花費」的核心語義。

quiz.question: What is the primary focus of this article?

options.A: To provide a step-by-step guide on how to switch energy providers.
options.B: To explain the political causes behind the war in Iran and its global impact.
options.C: To analyze the history of the UK energy market over the last decade.
options.D: To discuss the upcoming energy price increases and how households can manage the financial impact.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。全文的核心在於探討即將到來的能源帳單上漲（第一、二段）、政府的補貼措施（第三段）、供應商的利潤爭議（第四段），以及家庭如何透過節能與管理方式因應（第五、六段）。選項 A 僅是文章的一小部分建議；選項 B 僅作為背景提及；選項 C 則完全超出了文章內容範圍。
